title: Spot Phishing Messages
description: Learn to identify fake messages designed to steal your personal information. You will inspect sender details, URLs, and language patterns used by scammers.

lessons.title: What is phishing?
lessons.content: Phishing is when someone pretends to be a trusted organisation to trick you into sharing personal information like passwords, bank details, or OTPs.

lessons.title: Inspect the sender
lessons.content: Look at these messages and tap on the red flags you can spot in the sender's details.

lessons.title: Check the URL
lessons.content: Compare the real and fake URLs. Can you tell which one leads to the actual website?

lessons.title: What did you learn?
lessons.content: Think about a message you received recently. Were there any of these warning signs?

lessons.title: Your safety checklist
lessons.content: Keep this checklist handy to check any suspicious message you receive.

title: UPI and Digital Banking Safety
description: Understand how UPI collect requests, QR code scams, and fake banking apps work. Learn to protect your money when using digital payments.

lessons.title: How UPI works
lessons.content: UPI (Unified Payments Interface) lets you send and receive money instantly. But scammers have found ways to trick people into sending money when they think they are receiving it.

lessons.title: The collect request trick
lessons.content: Someone sends you a collect request saying they are 'sending' you money. What should you do?

lessons.title: QR code dangers
lessons.content: Scanning a QR code to 'receive' money actually sends money to the scammer. Let us see how this works.

lessons.title: Reflection
lessons.content: Have you ever received a collect request from someone you did not know?

lessons.title: Banking safety checklist
lessons.content: Steps to keep your UPI and bank accounts safe.

title: Spot Deepfakes and AI Images
description: Learn to identify images and videos that have been created or manipulated using AI. Look for visual artifacts, inconsistencies, and context clues.

lessons.title: What are deepfakes?
lessons.content: Deepfakes are images, videos, or audio created by AI to look and sound like real people. They can be used to spread false information.

lessons.title: Find the artifacts
lessons.content: Zoom into these images and tap on areas that look unnatural — extra fingers, warped text, impossible reflections.

lessons.title: Compare two images
lessons.content: One of these images is AI-generated. Can you tell which one? Look for subtle differences.

lessons.title: Reflection
lessons.content: How confident do you feel about spotting AI-generated images now?

lessons.title: Deepfake detection checklist
lessons.content: Steps to verify if an image or video might be AI-generated.

title: Smartphone Security Basics
description: Learn essential smartphone security practices: app permissions, software updates, strong passwords, and how to spot suspicious apps.

lessons.title: Why phone security matters
lessons.content: Your smartphone contains your personal data, bank accounts, and communications. Keeping it secure protects all aspects of your digital life.

lessons.title: Check app permissions
lessons.content: Review these app permission requests. Which ones seem excessive for the type of app?

lessons.title: Spot the fake app
lessons.content: Look at these app store listings. Can you tell which app might be malicious?

lessons.title: Reflection
lessons.content: Check your phone now — are there any apps you no longer use that still have access to your camera or contacts?

lessons.title: Phone security checklist
lessons.content: Essential steps to keep your smartphone secure.

title: Understanding AI and How It Works
description: Learn what AI can and cannot do, how AI-generated content is made, and how to use AI tools responsibly without being misled.

lessons.title: What is AI?
lessons.content: AI (Artificial Intelligence) refers to computer programs that can learn from data and perform tasks that normally require human thinking. Not all AI claims are accurate.

lessons.title: AI can be wrong
lessons.content: See examples where AI gave confident but incorrect answers. Learn why AI 'hallucinations' happen.

lessons.title: AI in your daily life
lessons.content: Identify which of these everyday services use AI — and what that means for you.

lessons.title: Reflection
lessons.content: How do you decide whether to trust information given by an AI tool?

lessons.title: Responsible AI use checklist
lessons.content: Guidelines for using AI tools safely and critically.

title: Common Scam Patterns in India
description: Recognise the most common scam patterns used in India: lottery scams, KYC fraud, parcel delivery tricks, and fake customer care numbers.

lessons.title: The anatomy of a scam
lessons.content: Most scams follow a predictable pattern: urgency, authority, fear, and a demand for action. Learning to spot this pattern is your best defence.

lessons.title: Identify red flags
lessons.content: Read these real-world scam messages and identify the manipulation techniques being used.

lessons.title: The KYC scam
lessons.content: Your bank 'calls' to say your KYC is expiring. Walk through the conversation and spot where it becomes suspicious.

lessons.title: Reflection
lessons.content: Has anyone in your family received a call claiming to be from a bank? What happened?

lessons.title: Scam defence checklist
lessons.content: Steps to protect yourself and your family from common scams.
